_notes: What 'exchangesim start' brings up, in this order. Order matters on the
way up and on the way down: the board is a client of the venues, so it
starts last and stops first, and each service is waited for before the
'config' points at the service's own file, and every port comes from
there -- this file never repeats one. 'kind': 'web' selects the board
process; anything else is a venue. A fourth exchange is a fourth entry
here and a fourth config file, nothing more.
Paths are relative to the project root (the parent of this directory).
Set 'root' to override that when the configs live somewhere else.
Each service writes var/log/<name>.log, rotated by the process itself at
'max_bytes' and keeping 'backups' older files, so an unattended run
cannot fill a disk. It also gets var/log/<name>.out, which captures what
the process says outside logging -- an import error, a traceback on the
way down. That file should stay empty; if it is not, read it first.
'log_max_bytes', 'log_backups' and 'log_level' may be set per service
for one chatty venue without raising the ceiling for the others.
